'''Enhanced Cloud City''' is the 21st Star Wars CCG product, published by Decipher in December 1999. It is twelve premium cards in four unique die-cut packs (5 Light Side, 7 Dark Side). CardGuide numbering: 21st product.

Each pack has three premiums (the first visible through the window) plus four [[Cloud City Limited]] boosters. MSRP $14.95; 12 packs per box. The four Cloud City boosters are reprints and are not listed.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref>

The four window cards are [[Boba Fett In Slave I]], [[Lando With Blaster Pistol]], [[IG-88 With Riot Gun]], and [[Chewie With Blaster Rifle]].

== Print sheets ==
Premiums print 11&times;11 (121 cards). Light Side: 6 titles 20&times; plus 1 blank; [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further]] is on the Light sheet. Dark Side: 6 titles 20&times; plus 4 blanks.<ref name="encyc" />
